name: local-user-enable-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): re-enables an existing local account. Needed because local-user-win's update path never flips the Enabled flag, so a re-plant after a team disables a planted account would otherwise leave it disabled. Vars: USERNAME (required). Pairs with disable-not-delete checks such as webdeploy_account_disabled. Idempotent.
